title: Private jet charter to and from Los Angeles
description: Private flights to and from Los Angeles: Van Nuys and John Wayne (Orange County) compared on night rules, customs and runways, from FAA and airport sources.
h1: Private flights to and from Los Angeles
lead: Los Angeles has several airports used by private jets, and their night rules differ. Two of the main ones compared, from official sources.

p: Van Nuys has {{kvny.runway}}. At night there are {{kvny.curfew}}. For flights from abroad there is {{kvny.customs}}.
At John Wayne, {{ksna.hours}}. There is {{ksna.curfew}}. The operator checks that the aircraft meets the limits before the flight is planned.

Every person travelling needs a valid passport and any visa the country asks for. The operator and its handling agent arrange customs, immigration and ground handling for your arrival and departure, and tell you where to meet the crew.

Your trip brief names the airport, where private flights are handled and the contact on the ground. Your broker stays with you from the first enquiry to the last landing, and follows up after the trip.

sections.h: How we plan a private flight to or from Los Angeles
p: Tell us where you are flying from or to, when, and how many people are travelling. We compare the airports around Los Angeles for your times and your aircraft, find aircraft from licensed operators, check each operator before you see a quote, and name the operator in your quote and agreement. Any aircraft, any route, upon availability.

Airport rules change at short notice. The operator and its handling agent confirm the current rules for your flight before departure; every fact on this page shows its source and the date we checked it.

faq.q: Can a private jet leave Van Nuys at night?
Does Archē Executive operate the flight?
faq.a: No. We are a broker. A licensed operator flies every trip, and it is named in your quote and charter agreement before you confirm.
